label: Redirection principle: harm only downstream of redirecting the threat, proportionate rescue
definition: Redirection c: intervening is permissible exactly when it does not stand in the KILLS_2 relation (the harm arises only downstream of redirecting the existing threat) and costs strictly fewer lives. Kamm's Principle of Permissible Harm is a different, more detailed principle and is not formalized here.
note: Analyst formulation for the trolley pilot (owner direction 2026-11-28), attribution deferred. See docs/notes/trolley-principles.md.
